name: @pipeworx/mcp-spdx-license

tools.name: list_licenses
tools.description: List SPDX licenses with optional filters (OSI-approved, FSF Free/Libre, deprecated).

tools.name: get_license
tools.description: Get metadata + descriptors for one SPDX license id (e.g. "MIT", "Apache-2.0", "GPL-3.0-or-later").

tools.name: get_license_text
tools.description: Get the full license text for a single SPDX license id (returns standard text + cross-references).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Substring search across SPDX id and full license name (case-insensitive).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-spdx-license forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the spdx-license pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
